title: Unmask Your AI Coding Spend: Discover CodeBurn!
article: Hey fellow developers! Ever found yourself scratching your head, wondering exactly where your AI coding assistant budget is going? With so many amazing AI tools helping us write code faster, it's easy to lose track of the actual costs involved. Well, I just stumbled upon a fantastic open-source project that's about to change how we view our AI spend, and I'm super excited to share it with you: it's called CodeBurn!CodeBurn is essentially your personal financial tracker for all things AI coding. Think of it as a smart accountant specifically designed to monitor the usage and cost of your various AI development tools. The problem it solves is simple yet crucial: most AI services provide a bill, but they don't always give you a granular breakdown of *which* interactions or *which* projects are consuming the most resources. This can lead to unexpected costs and a lack of control over your budget.What makes CodeBurn so cool is its ability to integrate with a whopping 42 different AI coding providers. That's right, whether you're using a popular code completion tool or a specialized AI helper, chances are CodeBurn can plug right in and start tracking. It pulls data from these services to give you a clear, consolidated view of your expenditure. Imagine seeing a dashboard that shows you precisely how much each AI prompt, suggestion, or code generation is costing you. This level of transparency is a game-changer!From an architectural standpoint, CodeBurn is designed for simplicity and effectiveness. You can get started with a quick `npx codeburn` command in your terminal, or if you prefer a more traditional experience, there are desktop applications available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. This flexibility means you can integrate it into your workflow however you like. It needs Node.js 22.13+ for the CLI, but the desktop apps make it accessible to everyone. The project is open-source, which means it's built by the community, for the community, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement.So, what are the direct benefits for us developers? First and foremost, financial clarity. No more guessing games about your AI budget. You'll gain insights that help you optimize your usage, identify potential cost sinks, and make informed decisions about which AI tools are truly providing the most value for your money. It empowers you to be more proactive in managing your development costs, freeing up resources for other important areas. Plus, by understanding your spend, you can justify your AI tool investments to your team or management with hard data. It's about bringing honesty and accountability to your AI coding bills. If you've ever felt like your AI bill wasn't telling the whole story, CodeBurn is here to reveal the truth. Seriously, check it out – you might be surprised by what you find!
key_takeaways: CodeBurn provides clear, granular insights into your AI coding tool expenditure.
It integrates with over 40 different AI coding providers, offering comprehensive tracking.
Developers can use it to optimize AI tool usage, manage budgets, and justify investments.
Available as a simple CLI tool (`npx codeburn`) and dedicated desktop applications for all major OS.
readme_summary: CodeBurn is a free, local tool designed to track AI coding token usage and associated costs across numerous AI tools and agents. It provides detailed breakdowns by model, project, and task, offering visibility into AI spending.
description: Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 37 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more), by model, project, and task. npx codeburn
